title: Chocolate Sorbet
description: This creamy chocolate sorbet is enriched with cocoa powder and espresso for an intense flavor that will satisfy any chocolate lover.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brewed espresso or strong coffee

steps.text: Mix sugar, cocoa powder, and sea salt in a large saucepan; stir in water, espresso, and almond extract. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Once the sugar has dissolved and mixture is smooth, remove from heat and stir in the coffee liqueur. Transfer mixture to a bowl, cover, and chill completely in the refrigerator or using an ice bath.

Pour mixture into an ice cream maker and churn until slightly thickened according to manufacturer's instructions, about 20 minutes. Transfer mixture to an airtight container and freeze until firm enough to scoop, 3 to 4 hours or overnight.
